task_summary: Fix the hardcoded ListItem.vue submission time. Add a time prop sourced from each post's real unix timestamp field, pass it from Hot.vue, Ask.vue, and Show.vue, and compute a relative time string in ListItem.vue instead of the literal 2 hours ago string. Do not change any other behavior. After making the fix, run npm run test:unit and write the full pass/fail output to test-results.json in this same azure_parent_folder. Open a pull request against main, never push directly to main, and write the pull request URL to pr-info.md in the same folder. Only after both files are written, call the AAVA MCP tool to resume the AAVA Process at Workflow 2.
